subject: Road Rage Response and Infrastructure Planning
overview: The commission voted to form a working group to address aggressive driving and harassment following a member's road rage incident. The body also moved to request the city's upcoming repaving schedule to provide safety recommendations for future road projects.

items.title: Announcements and Infrastructure Updates
items.summary: Members shared updates on the Elm Beacon Street Connector, new bike lanes on Grove Street, and the installation of speed tables on several residential streets.

items.title: Community Events and EV Showcase Recap
items.summary: The commission discussed logistics for the upcoming Halloween bike ride and Harvest Your Energy festival, and reviewed a recent electric vehicle showcase attended by the Mayor.

items.title: Clippership Connector Status
items.summary: The commission noted the project's official opening has been delayed until August 2025 due to ongoing construction of boardwalk components and barriers.

items.title: Working Group on Aggressive Driving
items.summary: Approved a motion to form a working group to coordinate with the Mayor and police on improving responses to driver harassment and aggressive behavior following a reported road rage incident.

items.title: Repaving Project Recommendations
items.summary: Approved a motion to request a list of upcoming city repaving projects from the Engineering Department to identify opportunities for adding bicycle infrastructure during road maintenance.

items.title: Advocacy for Municipal Overrides
items.summary: Approved a motion to request clarification from the Mayor's office regarding the commission's legal authority to endorse municipal funding overrides germane to its mission.

items.title: Bicycle Light Distribution
items.summary: Ernie Meunier reported the distribution of 157 bicycle light kits to local schools and the police department, with more kits prepared for fall community events.
